basic_details.job_title: Chitradurga District Health Department Pharmacy Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 24 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Twenty-four Pharmacy Officer (Pharmacy Adhikari) posts are to be filled on a contract basis in the taluk hospitals, community health centres and primary health centres of Chitradurga district. The Office of the District Health and Family Welfare Officer (Jilla Arogya Mattu Kutumba Kalyana Adhikarigala Kacheri), Zilla Panchayat, Chitradurga, Government of Karnataka, has invited applications from D.Pharma holders registered with the Karnataka Pharmacy Council. Applications with biodata and attested copies of documents are to be submitted to the office at P.B. Road, Chitradurga-577501, from 2 Nov

content_sections.heading: About Chitradurga Health Department
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Health and Family Welfare Officer functions under the Zilla Panchayat, Chitradurga, Government of Karnataka, from P.B. Road, Chitradurga. This recruitment fills Pharmacy Officer vacancies in the district's taluk hospitals, community health centres and primary health centres. It follows the official memorandum of the Commissioner, Health and Family Welfare Services, Bengaluru (No. E-Office-1840947 dated 15-06-2026) and the approval of the Chief Executive Officer, Chitradurga dated 23-09-2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice, issued as a press notification, says interested candidates may submit their application to the issuing office from 2 November 2026 (the date of the press notification) up to 5.30 pm on 16 November 2026. The application address is: Office of the District Health and Family Welfare Officer, P.B. Road, Chitradurga-577501 The notice does not prescribe an application form. Candidates are to submit a biodata (bio-data) together with attested copies of their qualification documents. The notice does not mention whether the application should be sent by post or delivered by hand, and it gives no instruction for the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 24 vacancies are for one post, Pharmacy Officer, on a contract basis. The category-wise and horizontal reservation of the posts is printed in the notice as below. Eligibility conditions printed in the notice: Qualification: D.Pharma, obtained only from institutions (schools) recognised by the Government of Karnataka. Registration: registration with the Karnataka Pharmacy Council is compulsory. Age limit: the candidate's age should be within 45 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age and no age relaxation. Pay: not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Along with the biodata, the notice lists these documents (as attested copies of the qualification documents): 01 passport size photograph Aadhaar card SSLC marks card D.Pharma marks card Certificate of registration with the Karnataka State Pharmacy Council Caste certificate Rural candidate certificate Disabled candidate certificate Kannada medium certificate Ex-serviceman candidate certificate Project displaced candidate certificate Third gender candidate certificate

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be appointed on the basis of roster cum merit. The notice does not mention a written test or an interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contract for one (1) year or until regular Pharmacy Officers are appointed, whichever is earlier. The appointments are subject to the terms and conditions of the rules of the Health and Family Welfare Department. For more information, candidates may contact the Office of the District Health and Family Welfare Officer, Chitradurga, during office hours. Office phone: 08194-235464; email: [email protected] .

rows.details: Press notification for 24 Pharmacy Officer posts, Chitradurga

faq.question: Q1. How many Pharmacy Officer vacancies are in the Chitradurga recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 24 Pharmacy Officer posts on contract in taluk hospitals, community health centres and primary health centres of Chitradurga district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Chitradurga Pharmacy Officer posts?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted from 2 November 2026 until 5.30 pm on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Chitradurga Pharmacy Officer post?
faq.answer: A D.Pharma obtained only from institutions recognised by the Government of Karnataka, with compulsory registration in the Karnataka Pharmacy Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Chitradurga Pharmacy Officer post?
faq.answer: The candidate's age should be within 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Chitradurga Pharmacy Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: Submit a biodata with attested copies of your qualification documents to the Office of the District Health and Family Welfare Officer, P.B. Road, Chitradurga-577501, by 5.30 pm on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. How will Pharmacy Officers be selected in Chitradurga?
faq.answer: Appointments will be made on the basis of roster cum merit.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Chitradurga Pharmacy Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract appointment for one year or until regular Pharmacy Officers are appointed, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. How many Chitradurga Pharmacy Officer posts are reserved for women?
faq.answer: Seven of the 24 posts are in the women column: 5 under General Merit, 1 under SC (Category A) and 1 under Category 2(A).

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be attached to the application?
faq.answer: The notice lists a passport size photograph, Aadhaar card, SSLC and D.Pharma marks cards, Karnataka State Pharmacy Council registration certificate, and caste, rural, disabled, Kannada medium, ex-serviceman, project displaced and third gender certificates.
